emails.subject: URGENT: Significant Protocol Deviation - Study FTD-202 - Site 101 - Participant 101-008
emails.body:
Hi Kevin,

Please be advised of a significant protocol deviation for participant 101-008 in the FTD-202 study.

The participant missed their scheduled Week 12 visit today (May 15, 2023), which was a dosing visit for Part B of the study. All associated safety assessments, including blood draws and vital signs, were also missed.

The participant's caregiver called this morning to inform us of a family emergency that prevented them from attending. They were unable to provide a timeline for rescheduling at that moment.

We have documented this in the source and have attached the initial protocol deviation form. Please provide guidance on the following:
1. The window for rescheduling the visit and administering the dose.
2. How to handle the missed safety assessments.
3. Any additional documentation required beyond the standard PD form.

Thank you for your urgent attention to this matter.

Best regards,

Sarah Jones
Study Coordinator
Southview Research Center
(555) 123-4567

emails.subject: Re: URGENT: Significant Protocol Deviation - Study FTD-202 - Site 101 - Participant 101-008
emails.body:
Hi Sarah,

Thank you for the prompt and detailed notification. I have received the PD form.

I am escalating this to our Medical Monitor, Dr. Volkov, for immediate review and guidance regarding the missed dose and rescheduling window. The participant's safety is our top priority.

Please attempt to contact the participant/caregiver again this afternoon to check on their status and see if a tentative reschedule date can be set.

I will provide a formal response with a complete action plan as soon as I have feedback from the medical team, which I expect by EOD today or first thing tomorrow morning.

Best,

Kevin Murphy
Clinical Research Associate
Inovant Pharmaceuticals
(555) 987-6543

emails.subject: Re: URGENT: Significant Protocol Deviation - Study FTD-202 - Site 101 - Participant 101-008
emails.body:
Hi Sarah,

Following up as promised. I have discussed this case with Dr. Volkov. Please proceed with the following guidance:

1.  **Rescheduling:** Reschedule the participant for the Week 12 visit as soon as possible. The visit must occur within 72 hours of the original appointment time. Please prioritize all safety assessments upon their arrival.
2.  **Dosing:** The missed dose of the investigational product should be administered at this rescheduled visit, provided all safety assessments are within acceptable limits and the PI confirms it is safe to do so.
3.  **Documentation:** Please ensure this is fully documented as a significant protocol deviation in the eCRF and source. Detail the reason for the missed visit and all actions taken. Update the protocol deviation form with the resolution and upload it to the TMF.

Please let me know as soon as the visit is rescheduled.

Thank you for your diligence.

Best,

Kevin Murphy
Clinical Research Associate
Inovant Pharmaceuticals
(555) 987-6543
